confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a July 2026 window, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because summer demand and event-driven rate swings are large. Tax and tipping treatment follows the field definitions. The FX observation came from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page and was not opened directly. A secondary site showed 0.6947 for 16 October 2026, and the RBA 4 pm rate for 15 October was used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against high-cost North American metros (for example Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York) with a San Francisco premium on lodging and mid-range dining. No single comparable city was used.
